description: VN→ZH number transfer: Vietnamese 'hai' is a single word for the number 2 in every context, but Mandarin splits it into 二 (counting/ordinals/dates) and 两 (before a measure word). Learners carry the single VN form over and write 二个/二本/二斤. Rule zh-er-liang-measure rewrites 二 → 两 only when it directly precedes a measure word.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Fires only on 二 immediately before a measure word (个本只张条杯瓶件位双台辆碗块斤). The digit lookbehind excludes 二 inside a larger numeral (十二个, 二十); the 第 lookbehind excludes ordinals (第二个); dates and floors (二月, 二号, 二楼) never match because 月/号/楼 are not measure words.

positive.notes: 二个 → 两个 before the generic measure word 个.
二本 → 两本 before the book classifier 本.
二斤 → 两斤 before the weight measure 斤 (neutral market phrase).

negative.notes: 二月 (February) keeps 二 — 月 is not a measure word, must abstain.
第二 (ordinal 'second') keeps 二 — 第 lookbehind guards it, must abstain.
十二 (12) keeps 二 — the digit lookbehind blocks 二 inside a larger numeral, must abstain.
